name: Archive-based Agent Variant Search
mechanism: Branches versioned agent variants over a bounded code or configuration surface and retains diverse validated stepping stones instead of one greedy lineage.
use_when: The agent implementation has modular sandbox-testable components
Diverse variants may solve different task slices
avoid_when: The evaluator or deployment authority is inside the mutable surface
Generated changes cannot be sandboxed and code-reviewed
failure_modes: Benchmark exploitation masquerades as capability gain
Archive selection collapses to one noisy metric
